name: @teactjs/cli
description: CLI tool for the Teact bot framework — create, dev, build, generate

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/bin.ts ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --splitting --format esm --target bun --external vite --external vite-node --external esbuild --external commander --external @clack/prompts && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp -R src/lib/assets/. dist/assets/ && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/fix-dts.ts
